title: Bad Stitches Trio
description: A blue demonic figure with horns and a black coat stands beside a blonde woman in a blood-stained yellow dress holding a cardboard box labeled 'FRAGILE - TO THE VOID'. To her right is a bandaged mummy-like figure with a single eye visible. They stand in front of a stone archway covered in graffiti leading into a glowing yellow tunnel, with a red mailbox on the left.
